scenario_name: Ground Platoon Native Static Occupy V1
description: G1 native ground schema scenario-loader evidence. The platoon is spawned as Ground_Platoon_MVP and remains static inside the objective zone while Army/ground TASK_OCCUPY tasking state propagates through ScenarioLoader and TaskOrder -> LeaderIntent -> PilotReport. This scenario consumes the accepted native schema evidence only; it does not release route movement, terrain interaction, sensing, fires, effects, damage, or combat behavior.
